context: A teacher and student discuss a research paper
purpose: Teach: 無償/基調/結ば/保っ/欠ける/とらえる/所見/判っ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、無償ボランティアの実態、よくとらえる構成ですね。
lines.en: Your paper has a really thoughtful structure—it captures the reality of unpaid volunteer work well.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Nod in the voice. Generous but specific. Not effusive—the confidence of someone who reads papers often and knows what careful work looks like.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。基調となる仮説、データで結ばれた結論を保っています。
lines.en: Yes. The baseline hypothesis stays connected to the data through to the conclusions.
lines.style: Careful, precise. Ren is checking his own understanding while answering. Slight upward inflection mid-sentence, like he's laying out a logical chain he wants her to follow. Respectful of her expertise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 欠ける論点も、丁寧に補足されていますね。
lines.en: And you've addressed the gaps really thoughtfully—you didn't just skip over them.
lines.style: Light emphasis on 'thoughtfully.' Gentle surprise—the kind of thing that marks careful scholarship. She's noticing what he did, not what he didn't. Encouraging without being patronizing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 査読者の所見、おおむね前向きでした。
lines.en: The peer reviewers were mostly encouraging about it.
lines.style: Quiet exhale of relief underneath. He's been holding onto the feedback outcome. Matter-of-fact delivery, but the relief is audible in the steadiness. Testing the waters to see if she thinks he should feel good about it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本旨が判った瞬間、私も納得しました。
lines.en: When I saw what you were actually arguing for, I understood why the work matters.
lines.style: Slow, genuine realization in real time. Not 'I read it and thought it was good'—this is 'the moment the logic became clear to me.' Warm finality. The satisfaction of a thesis clicking into place.
